title: Defect Alert Management
description: AI-powered defect alert management for pharma quality assurance

steps.title: Defect Report Received
steps.description: Quality team receives automated defect alert from production line

data.body: Batch BAT-4231 has reported 3 quality deviations at Line 4. Severity: High. Product: Paracetamol 500mg Lot: L-2026-0881 Detected at: Compression Station #7 Immediate investigation required.

data.content: Automated Alert: System detects deviation → alert routed to QA team via WhatsApp with batch details and severity level.

steps.title: Investigation Assigned
steps.description: QA Manager assigns investigation team and initiates root cause analysis

data.title: Defect Investigation - DA-2026-0742
data.content:
Investigation #DA-2026-0742

Status:Under Investigation
Assigned To:Dr. Priya Sharma
Target Closure:48 hours

Root Cause Analysis

Compression pressure variance
Machine calibration drifted by 2.3%
RCA Initiated: QA team assigns investigation to domain expert with automated timeline tracking.

steps.title: CAPA Execution
steps.description: Corrective and Preventive Actions implemented based on RCA findings

data.body:
✅ Corrective Action Completed

Root Cause: Compression roller wear beyond tolerance (2.3% drift)

Actions Taken:
• Roller replaced (Part #: CP-8842-K)
• Calibration reset to baseline
• 3-hour stability test: PASS

Preventive Action: PM schedule updated — weekly calibration checks for Compression Station #7.

Next review: 14 days

steps.title: Closure & Monitoring
steps.description: Defect closed with monitoring period for recurrence tracking

data.body:
🔒 Defect DA-2026-0742 CLOSED

Total duration: 36 hours 22 mins
Closure reason: CAPA verified effective
Monitoring period: 30 days

⚠️ Recurrence alert: If similar defect occurs within 30 days, case auto-escalates to Senior QA Director.

data.content: Closure: Defect closed with auto-monitoring. Any recurrence within 30-day window triggers escalation.
